name: Google Play Age Signals API
plain: A Play API that tells an app whether a user is verified as an adult or in an age band, to help meet state laws.
meaning: Beta from late 2025. Google supplies age verification status for users in places with age laws (Texas SB2420, Utah). It returns a status and an age range, not a birth date. Law dates were contested in court.

android.store_policy: Beta; developers in affected states can request access; terms in Play Console
android.note: Status values include verified adult, supervised, unknown.

ios.note: Apple's equivalent is Declared Age Range.

limits.headline: Can learn if you are a verified adult, or your age range, not your birthday
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app asks Google Play, usually when you open it in a place with an age law
can: Find out if Google says you are a verified adult, supervised or unknown
Learn an age range instead of a birth date
Change what you see to match laws such as Texas and Utah rules
cannot: Use it on iPhone; Apple has its own Declared Age Range tool
Count on every date, since law deadlines were contested in court
limits.reach_label: An age band, on Android only
limits.differs: Android has this in beta from late 2025. iPhone uses a separate Apple tool called Declared Age Range.

story.what_it_is: A Google Play tool that tells an app if a user is a verified adult or in an age band.

marketing.name: Play Age Signals API
marketing.pitch: Lets apps get age verification status from Play to meet state laws on age.

story.for_you: You may be asked to verify your age once with Google. After that, apps learn only your status or age range, not your birthday or ID.
story.for_makers: Laws in Texas and Utah ask app stores and apps to handle age. The API gives a ready answer so makers do not run their own ID checks or store sensitive documents.

use_cases.example: A game gates mature chat or loot boxes unless the player is verified as an adult.
A social app limits messages from adults to teens when it sees an age band.
A dating app uses the signal to confirm users are 18 or older before showing profiles.
A streaming app unlocks mature titles only for verified adults.
A children's app confirms the user is under 13 and switches off ads and tracking.
A retailer blocks sales of age restricted goods for users not verified as adults.

story.android_note: This is a Google Play beta feature and is not part of Android itself.
story.ios_note: Apple has a separate Declared Age Range tool.

technical_bounds: Legal status in states changes quickly
Utah and Louisiana dates unverified here

history.change: Injunction 23 Dec 2025; later Fifth Circuit stay and Supreme Court did not vacate (per press)
